item.title: Texas app store age verification law blocked by federal judge
item.description:
📝 The Texas ‌App Store‌ Accountability Act (SB2420) requires Apple and other app marketplaces to confirm user age when a person creates an Apple Account. In a preliminary injunction that delays the implementation of the act, Judge Robert Pitman said that it violates the First Amendment and is "more likely than not unconstitutional. Apple says that the Texas law impacts user privacy.
🔗 Read more: https://www.macrumors.com/2025/12/23/texas-app-store-law-blocked/
